newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish '97 growth may rise to 5 pct - fin ministry.
newsitem.headline: Finnish '97 growth may rise to 5 pct - fin ministry.

text.p: Finnish economic growth may rise to five percent in 1997, head of the Finance Ministry's economics department Martti Hetemaki said.
The ministry's latest published forecast for this year is 3.9 percent. Its new forecast is due in February.

Hetemaki said in a TV-news interview late on Monday that the economic situation seemed better than earlier forecast by the ministry due to low interest rates, moderate inflation and strong domestic demand.
Forecasts for Finnish 1996 growth ranged from 2.5 to 3.0 percent.
